title: Add coverage for E2E tests
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Adds coverage support with istanbul, when running E2E tests. 
This ensures coverage for renderers, which aren't covered in unit tests with vite. 

`Partially Resolves #4494`

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Describe the way your implementation works or what design decisions you made if applicable.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [ ] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] :computer: have added unit/e2e tests (if appropriate)
- [ ] :notebook: have added documentation (if appropriate)
- [ ] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

comments.author: Yokozuna59
comments.body: Updating the `packageManger` in `package.json` won't be enough, you have to delete the whole `pnpm-lock.yaml` to make sure old stuff from previous version was overwritten.
comments.label_reasoning: The comment points out that the code change (updating packageManager in package.json) does not fully achieve the intended behavior — the lock file also needs to be deleted to ensure the update takes full effect. This is a semantic deviation where the code's behavior doesn't match the intent.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment requests a concrete action: deleting the `pnpm-lock.yaml` file to ensure old data from the previous version is overwritten, in addition to updating `packageManager` in `package.json`.
